name: Plansch Cafe Bar
kurzbeschreibung: **Splash Café Bar in Innsbruck** – your cozy spot for a refreshing break in the heart of the city. Whether you're craving a **Kaiserschmarrn** with apple compote or a cold **Radler**, our relaxed vibe and sunny terrace make it the perfect place to unwind after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes. Try our homemade **Apfelstrudel** or a hearty **Käsespätzle**—local flavors that hit the spot. Open daily, we’re just a stone’s throw from the **Goldenes Dachl**, so drop by for a taste of Innsbruck’s best! 🌞☕
